_about: Caption text for the 20 Nov screenshot set (design/app-store-screenshots/directions/e-crew-story), frame by frame. The app screens inside the phones stay in English. Keep 'DayXero', 'Day Xero', 'DayXero Pro', 'SOS', 'Xero', 'Jelli' and 'Glim' as they are.

01.headline: Quit smoking & vaping. No cold turkey.
01.subhead: Get your mind ready in 7 days, then quit on Day Xero.
bubbles: I'm Jelli. Cravings? I've got you.
Glim here. I check in at night.
Hi, I'm Xero. We'll take it one day at a time.

02.headline: Prep for 7 days. Then quit on Day Xero.
02.subhead: Keep using as normal while you learn how your habit works.
bubbles: One stone a day. I'll walk it with you.

03.headline: One small step, every day.
03.subhead: Xero shows you what's next and cheers every step you take.

04.headline: Learn your habit, one card at a time.
04.subhead: Listen, reveal, myth or fact, try. Short cards on how the habit really works.
bubbles: One card at a time. No rush.

05.headline: Craving hits? Jelli breathes with you.
05.subhead: Tap SOS anytime. Ride the wave out together, one breath at a time.

06.headline: Slipped? Nothing resets.
06.subhead: Tell Jelli what happened. Your days stay, and you plan for next time.
bubbles: No guilt. Let's plan for next time.

07.headline: Wind down with Glim every night.
07.subhead: A one-minute check-in with Glim, then a slow breath before bed.
bubbles: How was today? Tell me, then rest.

08.headline: A calm tool for every wave.
08.subhead: Box breathing, grounding and noticing the urge, one tap away in Calm.

09.headline: Celebrate progress, not perfection.
09.subhead: Badges as your days add up. Every wave you ride out counts.

10.headline: Your Day Xero is waiting.
10.subhead: 7 days to get ready. A crew that's got your back the whole way.
